name: 'Setup Callisto Environment'
description: 'Sets up Rust toolchain, Cargo cache, moon and the .prototools toolchain, and Callisto CLI'
inputs:
  source:
    description: 'Where to obtain Callisto: auto installs the requested release version; local builds validated Callisto checkout source and ignores version. Release jobs must use local.'
    required: false
    default: 'auto'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's
      own invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling
      back to the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  verification:
    description: >-
      Attestation verification of the prebuilt release asset (gh attestation verify, repo
      orin-dx/callisto, signer workflow callisto-release.yml, source ref refs/heads/main). One of: require = a failed
      verification or missing gh aborts the step and the asset is never run; fallback (default) =
      on failure or missing gh, warn, delete the asset and install from crates.io instead (never
      run the unverified asset); skip = do not verify, warn, and use the asset. Releases built
      before the first attested release carry no attestation, hence the fallback default.
    required: false
    default: 'fallback'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"

    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true

    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: ${{ inputs.verification }}
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

1. Secrets: no user-supplied URL, remote, token, env value or path that may carry credentials is printed in any message, error, JSON or log. Print only values we derived ourselves (owner/repo slug, package names). Child processes get the runner's filtered environment.

4. Validation order: mode/eligibility first, then input validation, then prompts or side effects. A bad input never reaches a confirmation screen.
5. Optional conveniences (preselection, detection, previews, hints) degrade with a warning; they never make the command fail.
6. Never parse text we rendered, and never hand-parse a foreign grammar (Markdown, git URLs, shell) beyond the coarse classification we need; prefer the owning tool or omit.

8. Edge inputs for anything touching user paths or strings: spaces, newlines, leading ':' or '-', unicode, empty, very long.
9. Tests: one test per behaviour through the real binary where users see it; tests clean up children and temp files on failure.
10. Precedent: when a behaviour has a well-known precedent (git, cargo, npm, changesets), follow it and cite it rather than inventing.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs or builds the Callisto binary; callisto-action calls it directly by path.
set -euo pipefail

# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
# "git add -A").
CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"

if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
  exit 1
fi

# Without an override, install the release this action's ref is pinned to (`callisto@X.Y.Z`), else the latest;
# a failed tag lookup fails the step, and a named ref such as `v1` stands for its commit.
if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1
  fi
  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
  fi
fi

# Validate verification mode
VERIFICATION="${INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION:-fallback}"
case "$VERIFICATION" in
  require|fallback|skip) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto verification '$VERIFICATION' (valid values: require, fallback, skip)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)

if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == *"mingw"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"msys"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"windows"* ]]; then
  ASSET_NAME=""
else
  ASSET_NAME=""
fi

if [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
fi

# "latest" installs whatever crates.io resolves; a tag (`callisto@0.5.0` or `callisto-cli@0.5.0`) is stripped to bare semver.
CRATE_VERSION="${TAG_NAME#callisto@}"; CRATE_VERSION="${CRATE_VERSION#callisto-cli@}"

# Download under $RUNNER_TEMP with ASSET_NAME's extension: Windows assets are zip, which tar cannot read.
case "$ASSET_NAME" in
  *.zip)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.zip"
    ;;
  *.tar.gz)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
  *)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
esac

# A prebuilt asset runs with job privileges, so it needs a release-workflow attestation before extraction.
# require aborts on failure; fallback discards the asset and returns 1; skip trusts it.
verify_asset() {
  local reason=""
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "skip" ]]; then
    echo "::warning::verification=skip: $ASSET_NAME was not verified"
    return 0
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    reason="gh is not installed"
  elif ! gh attestation verify "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" \
      --repo orin-dx/callisto \
      --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
      --deny-self-hosted-runners \
      --source-ref refs/heads/main; then
    reason="attestation verification failed"
  fi
  [[ -z "$reason" ]] && return 0
  rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "require" ]]; then
    echo "::error::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason (verification=require)"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::warning::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason; discarding it and installing from crates.io (verification=fallback)"
  return 1
}

# Download, verify and extract the prebuilt asset; nonzero means use the fallback chain.
fetch_prebuilt() {
  if ! curl -sL -f "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" 2>/dev/null; then
    if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "require" ]]; then
      echo "::error::cannot download $ASSET_NAME from $DOWNLOAD_URL (verification=require)"
      exit 1
    fi
    return 1
  fi
  verify_asset || return 1
  # Extract only the expected binary, never the whole archive.
  case "$ASSET_NAME" in
    *.zip)
      unzip -q "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" callisto.exe -d "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
      ;;
    *)
      tar -xzf "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" -C "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" callisto
      ;;
  esac
}

# Dependencies named callisto-cli do not establish checkout source ownership.
owns_local_source() {
  local workspace git_root metadata
  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1
  git_root=$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
  [[ "$git_root" == "$workspace" ]] || return 1
  git -C "$workspace" ls-files --error-unmatch -- \
    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
    .workspace_root == $workspace and
    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
}

if [[ "$SOURCE" == "local" ]]; then
  if ! owns_local_source; then
    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ -z "$ASSET_NAME" && "$VERIFICATION" == "require" ]]; then
  echo "::error::no prebuilt callisto asset exists for $OS_NAME/$ARCH_NAME (verification=require)"
  exit 1
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]] && fetch_prebuilt; then
  echo "Callisto downloaded from GitHub Releases ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io (latest)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" != "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --version "$CRATE_VERSION" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io ($CRATE_VERSION)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
else
  echo "::error::callisto $TAG_NAME is available neither as a prebuilt asset nor on crates.io"
  exit 1
fi

echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
fi

docs/architecture/release.md:58:GitHub Actions schedules jobs, transports artifacts, and injects credentials. Callisto validates source, provenance, plan, observations, transitions, terminality, receipts, and artifacts. Workflow shell must not reimplement those semantics. Recovery dispatch uses current orchestration on `main` with an explicit merged source SHA and runs credential-free `recovery-checks` instead of full `verify`. Planning and building run alongside the gate (`verify` or `recovery-checks`); `execute` and the release PR refresh wait for the `gate` job, so nothing is published or refreshed unless verification passed.
docs/architecture/release.md:133:Managed PR verification compares the original snapshot before staging and before moving the release ref. After a successful update, the action confirms the ref's exact new SHA and supplies it as `--applied-head` for the final check. The model validates the original update decision and allows only its selected PR's head to change to that SHA; the base, repository, PR roster and every other head remain unchanged. Create decisions keep strict equality until the PR is created. The action does not rewrite its decision or discard concurrency checks after its own effect.

    echo "tar() { return 0; }"
    echo "unzip() { return 99; }"
    echo "git() { return 99; }"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs or builds the Callisto binary; callisto-action calls it directly by path.
set -euo pipefail

# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
# "git add -A").
CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"
DOCS_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/blob/main/docs/install-in-ci.md"

if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
  exit 1
fi

# Without an override, install the release this action's ref is pinned to (`callisto@X.Y.Z`), else the latest;
# a failed tag lookup fails the step, and a named ref such as `v1` stands for its commit.
if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1
  fi
  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
  fi
fi

# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)
ASSET_NAME=""
if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
  esac
fi

if [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
else
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
fi
DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"

# The archive runs with job privileges, so it is verified against the release workflow's attestation before extraction.
install_release_asset() {
  if [[ -z "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
    echo "::error::no prebuilt callisto asset exists for $OS_NAME/$ARCH_NAME; install it yourself: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "::error::gh is not available, so the release attestation cannot be verified; install gh or follow: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi

  if ! curl -sSL -f --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"; then
    rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
    echo "::error::no prebuilt callisto asset $ASSET_NAME for $TAG_NAME could be downloaded; install it yourself: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi

      --repo orin-dx/callisto \
      --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
      --deny-self-hosted-runners \
      --source-ref refs/heads/main; then
    rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
    echo "::error::attestation for $ASSET_NAME did not verify; do not use this file: $DOCS_URL"
    exit 1
  fi
  # Extract only the expected binary, never the whole archive.
  tar -xzf "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" -C "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" callisto
  echo "Callisto installed from the verified GitHub release ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
}

# Dependencies named callisto-cli do not establish checkout source ownership.
owns_local_source() {
  local workspace git_root metadata
  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1

    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
    .workspace_root == $workspace and
    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
}

  if ! owns_local_source; then
    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
else
  install_release_asset
fi

echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
fi

# Install Callisto in CI

On GitHub-hosted runners, use the `setup-callisto` action. It downloads the release archive, runs `gh attestation verify` on it, and only then extracts the binary. It needs `gh` and has no fallback: if the release has no asset for the platform, the attestation does not verify, or `gh` is missing, the step fails and links here.

Everywhere else (self-hosted runners, other CI systems, containers), follow these steps.

## Verify and install a release

Pick the asset for your platform:

| Platform | Asset |
| --- | --- |
| Linux x86_64 | `callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 | `callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| macOS arm64 | `callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |
| macOS x86_64 | `callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` |

Then download, verify, and extract. Replace `callisto@X.Y.Z` with the release tag, or use `latest/download` for the newest release:

```bash
asset=callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
curl -sSL -f --retry 3 -o "$asset" "https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/callisto@X.Y.Z/$asset"
gh attestation verify "$asset" \
  --repo orin-dx/callisto \
  --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
  --deny-self-hosted-runners \
  --source-ref refs/heads/main
tar -xzf "$asset" callisto
```

- Verify before you extract. If `gh attestation verify` fails, delete the archive and do not run it.
- `gh` must be authenticated (`GH_TOKEN`) and recent enough to have `gh attestation verify`.
- Put the extracted `callisto` on `PATH`, outside your workspace so a later `git add -A` cannot stage it.

## Build from source

```bash
cargo install callisto-cli --locked
```

Add `--version X.Y.Z` to pin a release. This builds on the runner and skips attestation, so the crate and its dependencies come from crates.io as `Cargo.lock` resolves them.

## Pin the action by SHA

Reference `setup-callisto` (and `callisto-action`) by commit SHA with the release tag in a comment, for example `uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z`; the action then installs that release.
